name: toolrow-failure-badge-corner
description: A failed tool call marks its kind icon with a danger cross pinned to the icon glyph's bottom-right corner rather than opening a second inline column of ink beside the icon. The badge is a sibling of the seat, not a child: the cross reads at full strength outside the aria-hidden seat while still anchored to the 14px glyph's corner. Above 700px the icon slot pulls into the turn's shared --speaker-gutter while the rationale stays on the content edge; below 700px the slot leads inline at the content edge with the rationale one gutter later.

mutation.declaration: toolcallitem.module.css: .failureBadge { position: absolute; ... } - the position: absolute declaration reverted to static (so the badge becomes a flex column beside the icon again)
mutation.note: Reverting position: absolute to static fails at both widths on every axis (cross off icon corner, failed rationale shifted off clean rationale). On 2026-11-25, also mutation-tested the Option A desktop gutter pull by reverting styles/railseat.module.css .gutterPull to margin-left: 0: failed desktop (900px) with icon slot at 50.0 instead of rail origin 16.0 and rationale at 84.0 instead of content edge 50.0. Restored before the passing run.
